## Checklist

Everything here is public. Every commit is deliverable: `pnpm check` passes on it.

- [ ] Tests added, named after what they verify
- [ ] No coverage exclusion added without the issue that explains it
- [ ] No dependency added without a justification below
- [ ] Documentation of the package up to date
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits and carry no trailer
